fieldNotes.truckGate: No barrier arm, sliding gate, or checkpoint. The dock-side truck apron is reached by open driveways within the Bluegrass Industrial Park; no perimeter fence around the building. Open multi-tenant industrial-park layout.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No guard booth anywhere along the building approach. The street-facing side seen in Nov-2024 Street View is a flush office/flex frontage with employee parking — no booth.
fieldNotes.buildingCount: PFG occupies a unit in a single long multi-tenant industrial building; the parcel/perimeter box is scoped to the PFG portion and its south apron.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: A continuous bank of dock doors lines the south face at z19; ~28 estimated for the PFG-occupied section, but the building is multi-tenant so some doors may belong to neighbors — flagged.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Modest truck apron on the south side holds roughly a dozen trailers; no dedicated large trailer-storage lot, so dropYard=false and dropArea kept at 10-25.
fieldNotes.drivewayShort: Compact apron between the dock face and the bordering tree line / road — holds only 1-2 trucks deep on approach.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Site is in the Bluegrass Industrial Park (Jeffersontown / Louisville metro), inside the Louisville urban fabric — Urban.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur enters the property.
